The '''WLO-5 speeder tank''' was a one-person [[Hovertank/Legends|repulsortank]]<ref name="Reveal" /> used sometime during or after the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. It could change the position of its [[Engine/Legends|thrusters]], shift from a vertical position out to a horizontal configuration.<ref name="Cartel Market" />

{{Veh-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The WL0-RX1 Assault Tank's design inspired by elements from the [[The Bad Batch Season 1|first season]] of the [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]''.<ref name="Reveal" /><ref name="TBB">''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]''</ref> It first appeared as a mount in [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Cartel Market" />
